Name: AT Pleasant Goat and Big Big Wolf Themed Architecture
Author: 996to627
Description:
How to use: Make sure to download SMAPI and alternative textures.
Download the mod, extract the file and place them in the mod folder.
After entering the game, find the carpenter Robin purchasing the paint bucket, and left-click on the house to use it.
